provider_name: Revenue & Disaster Management Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
eligibility_en: Parent holds valid Uzhavar Pathukappu Identity Card (உழவர் பாதுகாப்பு அட்டை) issued by Tahsildar.

title_en: Tamil Nadu Fishermen Welfare Board Higher Education Stipend
description_en: Annual educational cash stipend for children admitted into Fisheries Science (B.F.Sc), Marine Engineering, and degrees.
provider_name: Department of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare, Tamil Nadu
eligibility_en: Parent holds Fishermen Welfare Board Passbook / Biometric Coastal Fishermen ID Card.

title_en: UDID Card: 100% Free Higher Education & Tuition Waiver for Differently Abled
title_ta: மாற்றுத்திறனாளிகளுக்கான 100% இலவச உயர்கல்வித் திட்டம் (UDID அட்டை)
description_en: Complete tuition and special fee exemption across all Government & Govt-Aided Colleges in Tamil Nadu + free bus pass.
description_ta: அரசு & அரசு உதவிபெறும் கல்லூரிகளில் முழு கல்விக் கட்டண விலக்கு + இலவச பேருந்து பயணம்.
provider_name: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Tamil Nadu
eligibility_en: Student possesses National UDID Card / Disability Certificate with >= 40% Disability.
eligibility_ta: 40% அல்லது அதற்கு மேற்பட்ட மாற்றுத்திறன் சான்றிதழ் / தேசிய UDID அட்டை உள்ள மாணவர்கள்.

title_en: Prime Minister Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for Ex-Servicemen Wards — Girls
description_en: ₹36,000 per year (₹3,000/month) for girl students pursuing professional degrees (B.E., MBBS, BDS, B.Pharm).
eligibility_en: Wards of Ex-Servicemen / Ex-Coast Guard personnel with valid Dependent Identity Card.

title_en: Prime Minister Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for Ex-Servicemen Wards — Boys
description_en: ₹30,000 per year (₹2,500/month) for boy students pursuing professional degrees (B.E., MBBS, BDS, B.Pharm).
eligibility_en: Wards of Ex-Servicemen / Ex-Coast Guard personnel with valid Dependent Identity Card.

title_en: Sri Lankan Tamil Refugee Camp Card: 100% Free Higher Education Scheme
description_en: 100% Full Free Tuition, Hostel, and Mess Fees in Government and Government-Aided Engineering and Arts & Science Colleges.
provider_name: Non-Resident Tamils Welfare & Rehabilitation Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
eligibility_en: Student and family residing in recognized Sri Lankan Tamil Rehabilitation Camps with valid camp identity card.

title_en: Tamil Nadu Transgender Welfare Board: 100% Free Higher Education Scheme
description_en: 100% Free Higher Education and tuition fee waiver in all State Universities (Anna University, Madras University, etc.).
provider_name: Tamil Nadu Transgender Welfare Board (Social Welfare Dept)
eligibility_en: Possess valid Transgender Identity Card issued by the Social Welfare Department.

title_en: 7.5% Government School Quota
title_ta: 7.5% அரசுப் பள்ளி மாணவர்களுக்கான இலவச தொழிற்கல்வி ஒதுக்கீடு
description_en: Benefits: 100% FULL FREE EDUCATION -> Complete Tuition Fee, Hostel, Mess, Books, and Exam Fees paid by Tamil Nadu Govt. Target Beneficiary: Students from TN Govt Schools.
description_ta: 100% இலவசக் கல்வி + தங்கும் விடுதி + உணவுக் கட்டணம்.
deadline: Verify current academic year portal cycle
eligibility_en: Eligibility: Studied continuously from Class 6 to 12 in TN Govt Schools; Admitted via Single-Window Counseling (TNEA, NEET, TNAU, TANUVAS, TNJFU, TNDALU). Target group: Students from TN Govt Schools.
eligibility_ta: தமிழ்நாடு அரசுப் பள்ளிகளில் 6 முதல் 12-ஆம் வகுப்பு வரை தொடர்ந்து படித்த மாணவர்கள். பொறியியல், மருத்துவம், வேளாண்மை, சட்டம் ஆகியவற்றில் ஒற்றைச் சாளர சேர்க்கை.

title_en: First Graduate Scheme (முதல் தலைமுறை பட்டதாரி)
title_ta: முதல் தலைமுறை பட்டதாரி கட்டண சலுகை
description_en: Benefits: ₹25,000/year (Non-Accredited courses) or ₹27,500/year (Accredited courses) direct tuition fee reduction. Target Beneficiary: First College Goer in Family.
description_ta: ரூ. 25,000 முதல் ரூ. 27,500 வரை ஆண்டு கல்விக் கட்டண விலக்கு.
deadline: Verify current academic year portal cycle
eligibility_en: Eligibility: Student must be the 1st person in the family to pursue a degree; Admitted through TNEA/Govt Single-Window Counseling. Target group: First College Goer in Family.
eligibility_ta: குடும்பத்தில் பட்டப்படிப்பு படிக்கும் முதல் பட்டதாரி மாணவர்.

title_en: Pudhumai Penn Thittam (Girls)
title_ta: புதுமைப் பெண் திட்டம் (மூவலூர் ராமாமிர்தம் அம்மையார் திட்டம்)
description_en: Benefits: ₹1,000 every month (₹12,000/year) directly credited into student bank account until degree completion. Target Beneficiary: Girl Students from TN Govt Schools.
description_ta: ரூ. 1,000 / மாதம் வங்கி கணக்கில் நேரடியாக வரவு.
deadline: Verify current academic year portal cycle
eligibility_en: Eligibility: Completed Class 6 to 12 in TN Government Schools; Enrolled in regular UG Degree, Diploma, or ITI. Target group: Girl Students from TN Govt Schools.
eligibility_ta: அரசுப் பள்ளிகளில் (6 முதல் 12-ஆம் வகுப்பு வரை) பயின்று கல்லூரிகளில் இளநிலைப் பட்டம், டிப்ளமோ பயிலும் மாணவிகள்.

title_en: Tamil Pudhalvan Thittam (Boys)
title_ta: தமிழ்ப் புதல்வன் திட்டம் (அரசுப் பள்ளி மாணவர் உயர்கல்வி உதவி)
description_en: Benefits: ₹1,000 every month (₹12,000/year) direct bank transfer for academic materials and books. Target Beneficiary: Male Students from TN Govt / Aided (Tamil Medium) Schools.
description_ta: ரூ. 1,000 / மாதம் வங்கி கணக்கில் நேரடியாக வரவு.
deadline: Verify current academic year portal cycle
eligibility_en: Eligibility: Studied Class 6 to 12 in Govt / Govt-Aided (Tamil Medium) schools; Enrolled in regular UG Degree or Diploma. Target group: Male Students from TN Govt / Aided (Tamil Medium) Schools.
eligibility_ta: தமிழ்நாடு அரசுப் பள்ளிகளில் 6 முதல் 12-ஆம் வகுப்பு வரை படித்து உயர்கல்வி பயிலும் மாணவர்கள்.

title_en: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC / ST / SCA / SCC
title_ta: ஆதிதிராவிடர் & பழங்குடியினர் போஸ்ட்-மெட்ரிக் கல்வி உதவித்தொகை
description_en: Benefits: 100% Full Tuition Fee Waiver in Govt and Self-Financing colleges + Monthly Maintenance Allowance. Target Beneficiary: SC, ST, SCA, SCC (Converted Christians).
description_ta: 100% இலவச கல்விக் கட்டணம் + பராமரிப்பு உதவித்தொகை.
deadline: Verify current academic year portal cycle
eligibility_en: Eligibility: Family annual income <= ₹2,50,000; Enrolled in Govt, Aided, or Self-Financing college courses. Target group: SC, ST, SCA, SCC (Converted Christians).
eligibility_ta: SC, ST, SCA, SCC மாணவர்கள். குடும்ப ஆண்டு வருமானம் ரூ. 2.5 லட்சத்திற்குள்.

title_en: Post-Matric Scholarship for BC / MBC / DNC
title_ta: ஆதிதிராவிடர் & பழங்குடியினர் போஸ்ட்-மெட்ரிக் கல்வி உதவித்தொகை
description_en: Benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement in Govt/Aided colleges + Non-refundable fees and monthly boarding allowance. Target Beneficiary: BC, MBC, DNC Students.
description_ta: 100% இலவச கல்விக் கட்டணம் + பராமரிப்பு உதவித்தொகை.
deadline: Verify current academic year portal cycle
eligibility_en: Eligibility: Family annual income <= ₹2,50,000; Enrolled in regular UG/PG or professional courses. Target group: BC, MBC, DNC Students.
eligibility_ta: SC, ST, SCA, SCC மாணவர்கள். குடும்ப ஆண்டு வருமானம் ரூ. 2.5 லட்சத்திற்குள்.

title_en: Free Education Scheme for BC/MBC 3-Year Degree
description_en: Benefits: 100% Free Tuition Fee in Government and Aided Arts & Science Colleges. Target Beneficiary: BC, MBC, DNC Students in Arts & Science.
deadline: Verify current academic year portal cycle
eligibility_en: Eligibility: 3-Year B.A., B.Sc., B.Com in Govt & Aided Colleges; First generation or income < ₹2,00,000. Target group: BC, MBC, DNC Students in Arts & Science.

title_en: Higher Education Special Scholarship (HESS)
description_en: Benefits: ₹8,000 per year (UG) / ₹9,000 per year (PG) special hostel allowance. Target Beneficiary: SC / ST / SCC Hosteller Students.
deadline: Verify current academic year portal cycle
eligibility_en: Eligibility: Enrolled in degree/diploma staying in recognized hostels; Income <= ₹2,50,000. Target group: SC / ST / SCC Hosteller Students.

title_en: PM-USP / Central Sector Scheme (CSSS)
description_en: Financial grant: ₹12,000/year (UG Years 1–3) & ₹20,000/year (UG Year 4 / PG). Administered by Department of Higher Education, MoE.
eligibility_en: Above 80th percentile in 12th Board Examinations; Family income < ₹4,50,000/year

title_en: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
description_en: Financial grant: ₹50,000 per year for all 4 years of study. Administered by AICTE, Ministry of Education.
eligibility_en: Girl students admitted to AICTE approved 1st-year B.E./B.Tech/Diploma (Max 2 girls/family; Income < ₹8,00,000)

title_en: AICTE Saksham Scholarship (PwD)
description_en: Financial grant: ₹50,000 per year for all years of study. Administered by AICTE, Ministry of Education.
eligibility_en: Differently-abled students with >= 40\% disability admitted to AICTE degree/diploma; Income < ₹8,00,000

title_en: AICTE Swanath Scholarship
description_en: Financial grant: ₹50,000 per year for entire degree. Administered by AICTE, Ministry of Education.
eligibility_en: Orphaned students, wards of parents deceased due to COVID-19, or Armed Forces martyrs

title_en: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
title_ta: ஆதிதிராவிடர் & பழங்குடியினர் போஸ்ட்-மெட்ரிக் கல்வி உதவித்தொகை
description_en: Financial grant: Full Course Fee Reimbursement + ₹10,000/yr Maintenance. Administered by Ministry of Minority Affairs.
description_ta: 100% இலவச கல்விக் கட்டணம் + பராமரிப்பு உதவித்தொகை.
eligibility_en: Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi students with >= 50\% in 12th; Income < ₹2,00,000
eligibility_ta: SC, ST, SCA, SCC மாணவர்கள். குடும்ப ஆண்டு வருமானம் ரூ. 2.5 லட்சத்திற்குள்.

title_en: Financial Assistance for Wards of Beedi / Cine Workers
description_en: Financial grant: ₹6,000 to ₹25,000 per year. Administered by Ministry of Labour & Employment.
eligibility_en: Children of workers engaged in Beedi manufacturing, iron/mica mining, or cine industry with valid Labour ID

title_en: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship
title_ta: ஆதிதிராவிடர் & பழங்குடியினர் போஸ்ட்-மெட்ரிக் கல்வி உதவித்தொகை
description_en: Financial grant: Full Tuition Fee + Living Expenses. Administered by Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment.
description_ta: 100% இலவச கல்விக் கட்டணம் + பராமரிப்பு உதவித்தொகை.
eligibility_en: OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying in Top Class Colleges; Family income < ₹2,50,000
eligibility_ta: SC, ST, SCA, SCC மாணவர்கள். குடும்ப ஆண்டு வருமானம் ரூ. 2.5 லட்சத்திற்குள்.

title_en: KSR Merit Scholarship & Aptitude Test — Up to 100% Tuition Fee Waiver
description_en: KSR Educational Institutions, Tiruchengode — offers scholarships worth ₹3.20 crore. Based on engineering cut-off marks and performance in KSR Scholarship Aptitude Test (SAT). Additional sports scholarship routes available reaching 100% waiver at national level. Benefits: Up to 100% tuition fee waiver based on cut-off or aptitude test score. Total scholarship pool: ₹3.20 crore. Sports route: up to 100% for national-level achievers.
eligibility_en: TN 12th engineering cut-off for cut-off route; or qualify KSR SAT exam. Sports achievers (district/state/national) also eligible.

title_en: SNS College of Engineering — 100% Full Scholarship (Cut-off ≥175)
description_en: SNS College of Engineering, Coimbatore publishes a 100% full scholarship category for students with +2 engineering cut-off ≥175. This covers tuition and may include additional support. Also available via SNS SAT for deserving students and through parent-status provisions. Benefits: 100% full scholarship — tuition fee covered. Hostel/transport may apply separately depending on category. Verify exact fee components for current cycle.
eligibility_en: +2 / 12th engineering cut-off ≥175 / 200. Also eligible: SNS SAT qualifiers and deserving students under parent-status provisions.

title_en: VSB Engineering — Cut-off 190+ → 100% Tuition + 50% Hostel & Bus
description_en: VSB College of Engineering Technical Campus, Coimbatore — published scholarship: engineering cut-off above 190 → 100% tuition fee waiver PLUS 50% hostel and bus fee support. Benefits: 100% tuition fee waiver + 50% hostel fee + 50% bus fee support.
eligibility_en: TN 12th engineering cut-off above 190 / 200.

title_en: VSB Engineering — Cut-off 185–189.75 → 100% Tuition Fee Waiver
description_en: VSB College of Engineering, Coimbatore — for students with engineering cut-off between 185 and 189.75: 100% tuition fee waiver. Benefits: 100% tuition fee waiver for the course duration.
eligibility_en: TN 12th engineering cut-off 185.00 to 189.75 / 200.

title_en: VSB Engineering — Cut-off 180–184.75 → 50% Tuition Fee Waiver
description_en: VSB College of Engineering, Coimbatore — for students with engineering cut-off between 180 and 184.75: 50% tuition fee waiver. Benefits: 50% tuition fee waiver for the course duration.
eligibility_en: TN 12th engineering cut-off 180.00 to 184.75 / 200.

title_en: Kathir College of Engineering — Cut-off ≥190 → 100% Tuition Fee Waiver
description_en: Kathir College, Coimbatore — scholarship policy: engineering cut-off ≥190 → 100% full tuition fee waiver for the course period. Also: ≥180 → 50%; ≥170 → ₹10,000 waiver. Benefits: 100% tuition fee waiver for all 4 years of the UG programme.
eligibility_en: TN 12th engineering cut-off ≥190 / 200 for 100% waiver.

title_en: Kathir College of Engineering — Cut-off ≥180 → 50% Tuition Fee Waiver
description_en: Kathir College, Coimbatore — cut-off ≥180 → 50% tuition fee waiver for the course period. Benefits: 50% tuition fee waiver.
eligibility_en: TN 12th engineering cut-off 180.00 to 189.75 / 200.

title_en: CARE College of Engineering — Cut-off 190+ → 100% Tuition Fee Waiver
description_en: CARE College of Engineering, Trichy — merit scholarship: 190+ → 100% tuition fee waiver; 180–189 → 75%; 170–179 → 50%. Benefits: 100% tuition fee waiver. (Also 75% for 180–189, 50% for 170–179).
eligibility_en: TN 12th engineering cut-off ≥190 / 200.

title_en: CARE College of Engineering — Cut-off 180–189 → 75% Tuition Fee Waiver
description_en: CARE College of Engineering, Trichy — cut-off 180–189: 75% tuition fee waiver. Benefits: 75% tuition fee waiver.
eligibility_en: TN 12th engineering cut-off 180.00 to 189.75 / 200.

title_en: CMS College of Engineering — Cut-off 175+ → 100% Tuition Fee Waiver
description_en: CMS College of Engineering, Namakkal — merit scholarship: cut-off 175+ → 100%; 171–175 → 75%; 166–170 → 50%; 160–165 → 25%. Sports scholarship also reaches 100% for national-level achievers. Note: "175" refers to the engineering cut-off scale, not percentage. Benefits: 100% tuition fee waiver for eligible students. Sports route available.
eligibility_en: TN 12th engineering cut-off ≥175 / 200 for 100% waiver. Sports (national level) also eligible for 100%.

title_en: VIT Chennai — Board/State/District Topper → 100% Tuition Fee Waiver
description_en: VIT Chennai — 100% tuition fee waiver for the first three board/state/district toppers. 80% tuition fee waiver for the first two school toppers with above 90% aggregate in Class 12. Benefits: 100% tuition fee waiver for board/state/district toppers. 80% tuition waiver for qualifying school toppers.
eligibility_en: State Board / District / School topper in Class 12. 100% waiver: first 3 board/state/district toppers. 80% waiver: first 2 school toppers with 90%+ aggregate.

title_en: SRM Institute — Entrance Score 98+ → 100% Tuition Fee Waiver
description_en: SRMIST — entrance-performance scholarship: SRMJEEE score 98+ → 100% tuition waiver; 94–97 → 50% waiver. Separate slabs exist for different SRMIST programmes. Important: criterion is entrance score, NOT 12th marks. Benefits: 100% tuition fee waiver for SRMJEEE score ≥98. 50% for 94–97.
eligibility_en: SRMJEEE score ≥98 for 100% tuition waiver. Score 94–97 for 50% waiver. Applicable to specified UG programmes — verify per programme.

title_en: JKKN Trust Merit Scholarship — ₹5,000 to 100% Tuition Fee Waiver
description_en: JKKN College of Engineering and Technology, Namakkal — Trust Merit Scholarship based on academic performance for both Government Quota and Management Quota students. Award ranges from ₹5,000 to 100% tuition fee waiver. Benefits: ₹5,000 to 100% tuition fee waiver depending on merit rank.
eligibility_en: Academic merit at Class 12 / admission marks. Open to Government and Management Quota students.

title_en: Labour Welfare Organisation — Beedi/Limestone/Cine Worker Children Education Assistance
description_en: Government of India educational assistance for wards of Beedi workers, Limestone & Dolomite Mine workers, and Cine workers. Ranges from ₹1,000 to ₹25,000 depending on class/course level. Applied through NSP portal. Benefits: ₹1,000 (Class I–V) to ₹25,000 (professional degree) per year depending on class/course level.
eligibility_en: Child/ward of registered Beedi worker, Limestone & Dolomite Mine worker, or Cine worker. Enrolled in Class I through professional degree.
